```sql
SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name, COUNT(se.student_enrolment_id) AS enrollment_count, s.student_id
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON s.student_id = se.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name
ORDER BY enrollment_count DESC, s.student_id
LIMIT 1;
```
